notes: Installed from the latest GitHub release. Two accepted signers: e1d3... is the Play App Signing certificate of the copy from Google Play (computed with apksigner from the copy on the reference device, versionCode 1), and 2d5f... is the developer's own certificate on the GitHub APK (MusicRadio-1.0.12.apk, versionCode 20, CN=abaye, OU=MusicRadio). The two are not interchangeable on one device: a Play copy cannot be updated in place by the GitHub APK.
